{title}

{body}

""" def _escape_and_trim(text: str) -> str: """ Escape HTML special characters and trim whitespace. """ return html.escape(text.strip()) def _render_points(points: List[str]) -> str: """ Convert a list of markdown‑style points into safe HTML
  • elements. Each point is expected to start with a dash or bullet. The function removes the leading marker and escapes the remaining text. """ if not points: return "" rendered = [] for p in points: # Remove common markdown list markers: '-', '*', '+' trimmed = p.lstrip(" -*+").strip() escaped = _escape_and_trim(trimmed) rendered.append(f"
  • {escaped}
